visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Five interpenetrating cubes of clearly different edge length, each on its own two-axis orientation, fused into one squat mound on the unchanged 28 mm circular foot. Wider than it is tall; every face is a flat square or a clean intersection triangle; no lobe, dome, sphere or round surface survives. No cube floats or detaches, the smallest face measures 5.77 mm2 and the sharpest convex edge is a 42 degree wedge 0.79 mm long, so there is no sliver facet and no blade. The mound stays inside the foot outline. These three views are byte-identical to the previous round's, which the Manager inspected in full, and all four bubble packets render the same images.
